data.body_html:
Imagine gliding across the calm Mediterranean as the sun dips behind La Concha, a glass of cava in hand, and a plate of perfectly paired tapas before you. This is the Marbella sunset cruise with tapas pairing—a culinary voyage that combines the best of the Costa del Sol: a private boat charter from Puerto Banús, a 5-course menu, and the golden hour light. Whether you're celebrating an anniversary or simply seeking a unique evening, this experience delivers luxury, flavour, and views that stay with you. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours, all inclusive.

What Makes This Sunset Cruise Special

Unlike a standard boat trip, this experience is curated around food and timing. You depart from Puerto Banús just before sunset, heading toward the Marbella coastline or Cabopino. The skipper anchors in a quiet cove, and the tapas pairing begins. Each course is designed to complement the wine or cava served, using local ingredients like Iberian ham, fresh seafood, and Manchego cheese. The boat is yours alone—no crowds, no set menus, just your group and the sea.

Available Boats for Your Culinary Voyage

This sunset cruise is available on our Tier A fleet: the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and feature comfortable seating, a sun deck, and a shaded cockpit—perfect for dining. For larger groups, consider upgrading to a Tier B boat like the Mangusta 80, though the tapas pairing is standard on Tier A vessels.

The Tapas Pairing Menu

Our culinary team designs a seasonal 5-course menu. A typical pairing includes:

  • Starter: Jamón ibérico with tomato bread, paired with a dry Sherry.
  • Second: Gambas al ajillo (garlic shrimp), paired with a chilled Albariño.
  • Third: Patatas bravas with aioli, paired with a Spanish rosé.
  • Fourth: Grilled octopus with pimentón, paired with a Tempranillo.
  • Dessert: Crema catalana with cava.

All drinks (wine, cava, beer, soft drinks, water) are included. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are available on request.

Price and Inclusions

The Marbella sunset cruise tapas pairing is priced at €749 for 2 hours (up to 11 guests). This includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel and insurance
  • 5-course tapas menu with wine pairing
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

No hidden extras. You pay once and enjoy. For longer cruises (e.g., 4 hours), pricing is available on request via WhatsApp.

Best Time for a Sunset Cruise in Marbella

Sunset times vary: in summer (June–August), the sun sets around 21:30, so departures are at 19:30 or 20:00. In spring and autumn, departures are earlier—around 18:00 or 19:00. The water temperature in summer averages 24°C, making it pleasant for a swim if you wish. We recommend booking at least one week in advance, as sunset slots are popular.

How to Book Your Marbella Sunset Cruise with Tapas

Ready to experience the best sunset on the Costa del Sol? Browse our full fleet or contact us directly via WhatsApp. We'll confirm availability, dietary needs, and meeting point (Puerto Banús, next to the Casino). Payment is secure online. For groups larger than 11, consider a Mangusta 80 charter with a custom menu.
